reference_sql:
WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per product with sales in 2025
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per product with sales in 2025
  SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue,
         SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category_name) AS category_revenue,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id) AS rn
  FROM product_rev
)
SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue, ROUND(100.0 * revenue / category_revenue, 1) AS share_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
alternatives:
WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per product with sales in 2025
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
),
category_total AS (  -- one row per category with sales in 2025
  SELECT category_name, SUM(revenue) AS category_revenue
  FROM product_rev
  GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT pr.category_name, pr.product_id, pr.revenue, ROUND(100.0 * pr.revenue / ct.category_revenue, 1) AS share_pct
FROM product_rev pr
JOIN category_total ct ON ct.category_name = pr.category_name
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_rev pr2
       WHERE pr2.category_name = pr.category_name
         AND (pr2.revenue > pr.revenue OR (pr2.revenue = pr.revenue AND pr2.product_id < pr.product_id))) < 3

solver.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY category_name, product_id),
r AS (SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue, ROUND(100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category_name), 1) AS share_pct, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id) AS rn FROM p)
SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue, share_pct FROM r WHERE rn <= 3
